svg.title: pgvector-cpu-check: Which CPU crashes your Postgres image?
svg.desc: A newspaper clipping. INFRASTRUCTURE. Which CPU crashes your Postgres image? Runs it on 7 CPU models, from a 2008 Intel to a Raspberry Pi and AWS Graviton2, and names the faulting instruction behind SIGILL. 13 popular images audited, 3 build bugs found. uses: intikhab49/pgvector-cpu-check@v1.
